U.note: Clear lamp with cap, base and glow, but the wax is a single fuzzy lump with a small dot, little merging or splitting, and the panel is generic.

V.note: Wax reads as a soft orange fill with hard-edged flat-cut glass and a cap that looks inverted, though the stretching and splitting is organic; the lamp goes dark when turned off.

W.note: Bulbous glass vessel with highlights, believable stretching wax column and a thoughtful panel; the shape is less classic but richly crafted.

X.note: Crisp metaballs that merge and split read nicely, but flat vector fill, a dark void in the glass and a tiny pooled puddle make it less luminous.

Y.note: Classic silhouette with chrome cap and base, glowing hot-core wax that stretches and merges slowly, and a clean toolbar, though the wax edges are slightly pixelated.

Z.note: Most atmospheric glass, glow and base with warm light from below, but the wax is murky and low-contrast and tends to fuse into one glowing mass.
